title: Squircles, Styles, and Spacing: How Your Feedback is Helping Improve Mobile
summary: We're working to more closely match your mobile and desktop experiences, including changes to server icons and the chat bar. (Did we mention Ash, the OG dark theme, is back?)
body:
In 2025, we refreshed the desktop app with players in mind, bringing new themes, more ways to customize, and a cleaner look. Now we're bringing mobile in line with it, so the two feel like one Discord. That also lets us ship updates across both more consistently and address some of the things you missed most. 

The OG dark theme’s back. People are circles, and things are squircles. The chat bar has more breathing room. These are some of the biggest changes in our latest mobile update that help make Discord feel more consistent across mobile and desktop.
